awakening.beyondsolo.window.cond_light: Found the hidden chapel and swore to the light
awakening.beyondsolo.awakened.body_light: Welcome, %s. You wake in the light.
depths.beyondsolo.hidden.chapel.desc: A chapel walled off from the temple's dark. Someone waits in its light.
depths.beyondsolo.hidden.enter.chapel: Warm light and white stone. Someone waits for you over the altar.
depths.beyondsolo.hidden.chapel.hollow: Light seeps through the cracks, and a bell answers. Knock again.
item.beyondsolo.envoy_feather.desc: A feather of the Envoy of Dawn. It is warm, and its light never fades.
item.beyondsolo.envoy_feather.use: Use: keep the vigil where you stand
light.beyondsolo.envoy.bound: The Envoy bows its head. The System is already yours, bound in the dark.
light.beyondsolo.envoy.sworn: The Envoy bows its head. The light already walks with you.
light.beyondsolo.envoy.turned_away: The Envoy lowers its hand. It will wait here while the temple stands.
light.beyondsolo.envoy.vigil: The Envoy watches over you. Hold the ring.
light.beyondsolo.mantle.verdict.title: Ruler of the Verdict
light.beyondsolo.mantle.verdict.sanctum: Every foe inside stands judged and takes 10%% more from every blow.
light.beyondsolo.mantle.verdict.lore: The light weighs every crown, and finds none worthy.
light.beyondsolo.mantle.wings.title: Ruler of Wings
light.beyondsolo.mantle.wings.sanctum: Foes are slowed, fliers most of all. Allies run faster and fall like feathers.
light.beyondsolo.mantle.wings.lore: Where the light flies, the sky belongs to no one else.
light.beyondsolo.mantle.hand.title: Ruler of the Unseen Hand
light.beyondsolo.mantle.hand.sanctum: An unseen weight presses every foe down, slowing it and pinning it to the ground.
light.beyondsolo.mantle.hand.lore: The light does not strike. It closes its hand.
light.beyondsolo.mantle.dawn.title: Ruler of Dawn
light.beyondsolo.mantle.dawn.sanctum: Foes catch fire. Allies mend twice as fast and shed harmful effects one by one.
light.beyondsolo.mantle.dawn.lore: Every night ends. The light sees to it.
title.beyondsolo.vessel_of_light.desc: Find the chapel hidden in the awakening temple and wake sworn to the light.
title.beyondsolo.ruler_of_verdict.desc: Take up the mantle of the Verdict at the Investiture.
title.beyondsolo.ruler_of_wings.desc: Take up the mantle of Wings at the Investiture.
title.beyondsolo.ruler_of_hand.desc: Take up the mantle of the Unseen Hand at the Investiture.
title.beyondsolo.ruler_of_dawn.desc: Take up the mantle of Dawn at the Investiture.
title.beyondsolo.dawn_over_crowns.desc: Sworn to the light, have a share in slaying a monarch from beyond the gates.
title.beyondsolo.unbroken_light.desc: Hold back a monarch's domain with your sanctum.
quest.beyondsolo.light_investiture.desc: The Envoy of Dawn calls you. Raise its feather in the overworld, hold the ring of light against the dark that comes for it, and take up a mantle. You will rise a ruler of light.
quest_objective.beyondsolo.light_investi: Keep the vigil and take up a mantle
quest.beyondsolo.story.main.throne_light: No throne waits for one sworn to the light. From level %s the Envoy of Dawn calls you: raise its feather, keep the vigil and take up a mantle.
quest_objective.beyondsolo.story.main.ma: Take up a mantle at the Investiture
quest.beyondsolo.story.main.father_light: Chapter V: The Vessel of Light
A new ruler of light draws the monarchs' eyes. The first of them to notice you is already on its way. Bring it down before it brings you down.
skill.beyondsolo.light_sanctum.flavour: Where a ruler of light stands, no other law is spoken.
skill.beyondsolo.light_sanctum.desc: Raise a dome of light for %s s, %s blocks round you, and carry it with you. Inside it you and your allies deal %s%% more, take %s%% less and mend %s%% of your health a second; every foe burns in the light (%s damage a second) and suffers your mantle's law, and no monarch's domain can touch those it shelters.
skill.beyondsolo.light_judgement.flavour: The light sees every sin, and answers each with a lance.
skill.beyondsolo.light_judgement.desc: A sigil marks every foe within %s blocks, and a lance of light falls on each: %s damage, stunned for %s s. The judged take %s%% more from every blow for %s s. Bosses are only stunned for a moment and take half as much more.
skill.beyondsolo.light_seraph.flavour: Wings of light, a halo, and the strength of the morning.
skill.beyondsolo.light_seraph.desc: Take the light's own shape for %s s, with wings and a halo of light. Your blows deal %s%% more and carry the light, you take %s%% less, move faster, are hard to knock back and fall like a feather. You can still be hurt.
skill.beyondsolo.light_blade_of_heaven.f: The verdict is spoken once, and it is the size of a tower.
skill.beyondsolo.light_blade_of_heaven.d: A sword of light the size of a tower falls where you look: %s damage to foes within %s blocks, stunned and thrown back (bosses stand their ground). It stands for %s s, and the ground round it burns them for %s damage a second and leaves them judged.
skill.beyondsolo.light_choir_of_wings.fl: Six wings rise behind you, and the sky answers with spears.
skill.beyondsolo.light_choir_of_wings.de: Six wings of light lift you and hold you up while %s feathers like spears fall on the foes within %s blocks, %s damage each, slowing them to a crawl. Lasts %s s.
skill.beyondsolo.light_hand_of_heaven.fl: A hand out of the sky, and nothing beneath it stays standing.
skill.beyondsolo.light_hand_of_heaven.de: A hand of light comes down where you look and closes on every foe within %s blocks: %s damage, lifted up and held for %s s, then slammed into the ground for %s more. Bosses are only stunned for a moment.
skill.beyondsolo.light_daybreak.flavour: Whatever the hour, the sun rises for you.
skill.beyondsolo.light_daybreak.desc: A sun rises over the fight for %s s: every second it burns the foes within %s blocks for %s damage and sets them alight, and mends you and your allies there for %s%% of their health. Then it flares out for %s damage.
notify.beyondsolo.light_sworn.title: [Sworn to the Light]
notify.beyondsolo.light_sworn.body: The System has bound to you in the light. Its first power waits on the crown keys: %s.
notify.beyondsolo.light_power.title: [A Gift of the Light]
notify.beyondsolo.light_power.body: The light gives you %s. It waits on the crown keys.
notify.beyondsolo.light_called.title: [The Light Calls]
notify.beyondsolo.light_called.body: The Envoy of Dawn calls you to the Investiture. Raise its feather in the overworld and keep the vigil to take up a mantle.
notify.beyondsolo.light_risen.title: A Ruler of Light Rises
notify.beyondsolo.light_risen.body: %s kept the vigil and rose as %s.
notify.beyondsolo.light_vigil_failed.gon: The vigil was broken. The light will call again in %s minutes.
notify.beyondsolo.light_vigil_failed.lef: You left the ring of light. The light will call again in %s minutes.
notify.beyondsolo.light_vigil_failed.fel: You fell during the vigil. The light will call again in %s minutes.
notify.beyondsolo.light_feather_cold.bod: The feather is cold in your hand. It only answers one sworn to the light.
notify.beyondsolo.light_feather_invested: The feather glows softly. You are already %s.
notify.beyondsolo.light_vigil_waits.body: The feather stays dim. Change your job and reach level %s first.
notify.beyondsolo.light_vigil_retry.body: The light is still gathering. Try the vigil again in %s minutes.
notify.beyondsolo.light_vigil_place.body: The light can't reach you here. Keep the vigil in the overworld.
notify.beyondsolo.monarch_sigil_light.bo: The sigil stays dark. You are sworn to the light, and no crown will have you.
ui.beyondsolo.light.clash.monarch: a monarch from beyond the gates
ui.beyondsolo.light.chapel.hum.title: Something hums behind the stone
ui.beyondsolo.light.chapel.hum.body: Golden light seeps through the cracks in the wall.
ui.beyondsolo.light.chapel.opened.title: The wall gives way
ui.beyondsolo.light.chapel.opened.body: Light pours out of the dark.
ui.beyondsolo.light.chapel.enter.title: Chapel of Dawn
ui.beyondsolo.light.chapel.enter.body: Someone has waited a long time for you.
ui.beyondsolo.light.called.title: The light calls
ui.beyondsolo.light.called.body: The Envoy's feather is yours. Raise it to keep the vigil.
ui.beyondsolo.light.vigil.failed.title: The vigil failed
ui.beyondsolo.light.vigil.failed.body: The light fades. It will call again.
ui.beyondsolo.light.vigil.held.title: The dark is held back
ui.beyondsolo.light.vigil.held.body: The Envoy comes down to you.
ui.beyondsolo.light.vigil.gather.body: Stand in the ring. The dark is coming.
ui.beyondsolo.light.vigil.between: Hold the ring. More are coming.
ui.beyondsolo.light.vigil.hold: Hold the ring and drive the dark back
ui.beyondsolo.light.investiture.body: The light has a new ruler. Its powers wait on the crown keys.
ui.beyondsolo.light.covenant.name: Envoy of Dawn
ui.beyondsolo.light.covenant.back: You came back. The light remembers you.
ui.beyondsolo.light.covenant.line1: Few ever find this door, and fewer still knock on it.
ui.beyondsolo.light.covenant.line2: Past this temple the Arbiter waits to weigh you, and the System would bind to you in the dark.
ui.beyondsolo.light.covenant.line3: Swear to the light, and the System will wake in you through the light instead, with all its powers.
ui.beyondsolo.light.covenant.line4: But the light wears no crown. Sworn to it, you will never sit on the empty throne.
ui.beyondsolo.light.covenant.means: Swear and you wake here with the light's powers on the crown keys, and no crown can ever be yours.
ui.beyondsolo.light.covenant.keys: Click or press 1 to swear · 2 to turn away · Esc to say nothing
ui.beyondsolo.light.mantle.sub: Choose the mantle you will take up. It will be yours for good.
ui.beyondsolo.light.mantle.every: Every mantle gives a sanctum with its own law and a ruler's strength: more health, heavier blows and more mana.
ui.beyondsolo.light.mantle.keys: Click a mantle or press 1-4 to choose · Enter to take it up
ui.beyondsolo.light.mantle.waiting: The Envoy waits for your answer
ui.beyondsolo.light.mantle.looked_away: The Envoy still waits. Press %s to answer it.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.light.swear: Swears them to the light at once, with the powers it gives at their level (a crown is taken back).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.light.unswe: Sets them free of the light: its powers and their mantle are gone.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.light.inves: Invests them with a mantle at once: a ruler of light, with its sanctum and authority.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.light.dives: Takes their mantle back; they stay sworn to the light.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.light.call: Calls them to the Investiture now: the light's notice, the Envoy's feather and the quest.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.light.vigil: Begins the vigil where they stand, whatever their level (next skips a stage, stop ends it).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.light.chape: Opens the Envoy's chapel in their running awakening trial and takes them before the Envoy.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.light.power: Uses one of the light's powers now: their mana is refilled and every cooldown cleared first.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.light.reset: Wipes their light record: never sworn, never called, no wait for the vigil.
command.beyondsolo.solo.light.sworn: %s is now sworn to the light.
command.beyondsolo.solo.light.unsworn: %s is no longer sworn to the light.
command.beyondsolo.solo.light.called: %s has been called to the Investiture.
command.beyondsolo.solo.light.chapel: %s stands before the Envoy of Dawn.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.not_sworn: %s is not sworn to the light.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.unknown_ma: Unknown mantle: %s. Use verdict, wings, hand or dawn.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.unknown_li: Unknown power: %s. Use sanctum, judgement, seraph or authority.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.vigil_refu: %s can't keep the vigil now (already invested, or not in the overworld?).
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.no_chapel: %s is not in an awakening trial with a chapel (or already has the System).
command.beyondsolo.solo.info.light: %s · monarchs slain %s · foes judged %s · authorities used %s
command.beyondsolo.solo.info.light_calle: called to the Investiture · vigils begun %s
command.beyondsolo.solo.info.light_not_c: not yet called to the Investiture
